scope: Training-only descriptive split-sensitivity diagnostic; no tuning, no test evaluation

models.extra_trees: 200 trees, max_depth=8, min_samples_leaf=5, max_features=1.0, seed=5576, n_jobs=4

features: Existing pooled GLoMo features: thirds means and q10/q50/q90, same as prior simple baselines
interpretation: Different fold constructions confound video exclusion and fold composition; a gap is descriptive, not causal proof. Hyperparameters retained from prior diagnostic; Ridge alpha was previously chosen on training group CV, so these are descriptive scores, not an independent nested-CV estimate.
